bio:
I’m a Backend & Platform Engineer ( Fullstack ) focused on building reliable systems and solving problems end to end, from architecture and backend development to deployment,UI design, infrastructure, and production operations.

At Kifiya, I work on a large scale loan platform, designing and developing event driven microservices across Go, Node.js, Kafka, and PostgreSQL. My work spans system architecture, service development, data flows, integrations, security, and the operational side of keeping production systems reliable.

I take ownership beyond writing code. I focus on understanding the business problem, designing the right system, implementing it, and making sure it works reliably in production. Outside of work, I build and experiment with personal projects, including RAG systems and recommendation driven applications, to continuously expand my understanding of distributed systems, backend architecture, and modern software engineering.
